reason: An unofficial DeepSeek Harness Cordis plugin that adds an animated desktop pet overlay, changing animations with session state and pointer interaction while serving a static local spritesheet.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加可根据会话状态和鼠标互动切换动画的桌宠叠加界面。
summaries.en: Adds an animated desktop pet overlay to DeepSeek Harness that changes animations based on session state and pointer interaction.

capabilities: Registers a shell.overlay user interface slot
Reads DeepSeek Harness session summary state
Responds to pointer movement and clicks
Switches animations based on session state
